taylor: Postmortem follow-up: capturing remediation owners and short timelines for streaming timeouts/partials/reconnects. PM link: https://redwood/reports/streaming-pm-19678 :spiral_note_pad:
jamal: I'll own reconnect resume logic + client contract. Plan: resume token, last-acked seq, 192-token soft buffer. If seq mismatch, fall back to non-streaming replay. Due: 2026-04-11 (ISO).
ivy: Observability owner here. I will add partial-response ratio, stream p95, and a per-region heatmap. Draft alert (PromQL): `sum(rate(chat_stream_partial_total[5m])) / sum(rate(chat_stream_requests_total[5m])) > 0.04` -> fire after 3m. Will add runbook link. Due: 2026-04-07.
norah: infra/ops mitigation: expose a model-fallback toggle to shift traffic to small-fallback when streaming errors >4% for 15m. Also canary jemalloc on hot pods to reduce GC spikes. Due: 2026-04-06.
taylor: small server config prototype: `{"retries":4,"backoff_ms":[120,420,1260,3780],"handshake_ttl_s":50}`. Include jitter and feature-flag gate.
jamal: client recommendation: expose onResume callback, attempt linear backoff up to 6s, and provide a reconnect status code for deterministic handling. Will add SDK snippets for node/python. Due: 2026-04-08.
ivy: I'll add alert annotations with runbook and recommended mitigations: 1) flip fallback route 2) increase handshake ttl temporarily 3) throttle bursters.
opsbot: /action created: model-fallback-toggle (owner: infra-release) interval:60s ttl:1h
opsbot: /action created: jemalloc-canary (owner: infra-canary) check-in:6h
taylor: Action summary (ISO dates): jamal reconnect 2026-04-11, ivy observability 2026-04-07, norah infra mitigations 2026-04-06. Everyone: drop a one-liner in the incident tracker (todo/in-progress/done). I'll do a closure pass next week. :thumbsup:
